prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Nickel (니켈) itself — the sovereign of the Nickel Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a quietly commanding adult woman with warm olive skin, rounded oval face, large amber-gold eyes, full gently arched brows, small softly modeled nose, muted coral lips and a tiny beauty mark beside her mouth.
Body and hair: curvy build; thick long silver hair swept into a high ponytail with two loose curled face-framing locks; warm nickel silver-grey hair with a fine criss-cross sheen like a polished meteorite slice.
Expression: a warm, gentle look with a faint smile.
Her element, carried in her design: nickel: a warm silver-grey metal that fell from the sky — iron meteorites are iron and nickel together, and when a slice is polished and etched a criss-cross lattice of crystal bands, the Widmanstätten pattern, appears that only millions of years of slow cooling in space can grow; it rests with iron in the Earth's core; miners cursed its ore as the 'copper demon' because it looked like copper yet yielded none; it shines as the silver of coins and mirror-bright plating, it is one of the three metals a magnet holds, and its salts dissolve into clear apple green; loyal, steady and patient.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Warm nickel-silver armor whose plates show the etched criss-cross lattice of meteorite metal, mirror-bright plated trim, apple-green indicator lights, magnetic grapple rings around the forearms, a small fallen-star core at the chest trailing a faint blue tail; steady and loyal; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow. Signature construction: broad nested U-shaped magnetic pole armor forms the massive shoulder blocks and shin guards, apple-green energy flowing between the poles, polished meteorite-crystal layered plates forming the fitted torso. Entirely hard-surface mecha armor with visible thickness, joints and panel lines; human face and hair, bare shoulders and deep chest opening as specified. No cloth cape, skirt or gown.
Colours: warm nickel silver-grey, etched meteorite crosshatch steel, apple-green nickel salt, deep night-sky blue.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, an asteroid-mining fleet in the belt: a mothership carved whole out of an iron-nickel asteroid, hull plates showing the criss-cross lattice of etched meteorite metal, magnetic grapples drawing tumbling metal boulders out of the dark, a bright sun glinting off every surface.
Pose: steady planted stance with one boot a little forward, both empty human hands relaxed beside her hips, head level and looking at the viewer. On a reinforced exterior landing platform close to the enormous iron-nickel asteroid mothership, a magnetic grapple towing a boulder behind her and bright solar reflections on the armor.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ni) and atomic number (28) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
